newsitem.title: RUSSIA: German President Herzog to visit Russia -Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: German President Herzog to visit Russia -Kremlin.

text.p: German President Roman Herzog will pay a state visit to Russia on the invitation of President Boris Yeltsin from August 31 to September 4, the Kremlin press service said on Thursday.
Herzog will tour Russia and meet Yeltsin, who first mentioned the invitation during a visit to Germany in April, as well as Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin and parliamentary leaders.

Germany is Russia's biggest trade partner, donor and political supporter in the West. Ties have been ruffled recently by the opposition-dominated parliament's blocking of Yeltsin's attempts to return looted wartime art treasures to Germany.
